name: ESP POTBELLY Raana Custom
description: A distinctive custom electric guitar combining ESP craftsmanship with a striking stage presence. Designed for musicians looking for a unique instrument with character, versatility, and a sound of its own.

name: ESP Ultratone ANON
description: A sleek electric guitar from ESP, offering a distinctive design for players who appreciate both visual identity and musical expression. A fitting choice for modern rock and expressive performances.

name: ESP M-II Roselia Sayo
description: A premium electric guitar inspired by the refined aesthetic of Roselia's Sayo. Combining a distinctive appearance with ESP's reputation for professional instruments, it is suited for demanding players and performers.

name: Schecter BC Ave Mujica / Doloris
description: A signature-inspired electric guitar associated with Ave Mujica's Doloris. Its distinctive styling makes it an eye-catching addition to any setup, while its Schecter identity appeals to rock and metal guitarists.

name: Schecter BC Ave Mujica / Mortis
description: An electric guitar inspired by Ave Mujica's Mortis, featuring a distinctive visual identity for musicians who want their instrument to stand out. A compelling choice for players drawn to expressive rock-oriented designs.

name: Schecter AC-EXB-5 Ave Mujica Timoris
description: A five-string electric bass inspired by Ave Mujica's Timoris. Its extended range provides additional room for musical expression, making it an interesting option for bassists exploring different playing styles.

name: ESP GB Soyo
description: A distinctive ESP electric bass inspired by Soyo. Combining an expressive design with the identity of a recognized instrument manufacturer, it is suited for bassists looking for a standout addition to their collection.

name: ESP BTL Roselia Lisa
description: An electric bass inspired by Roselia's Lisa, bringing together a recognizable visual style and ESP's instrument-making heritage. A fitting choice for bassists who value both musical expression and presentation.

name: Pearl Reference Series Kit
description: A premium drum kit from Pearl's Reference Series, designed for drummers seeking a professional instrument for rehearsals, recordings, and live performances. A centerpiece for any serious drum setup.

name: Tama Starclassic Performer
description: Part of Tama's respected Starclassic lineup, the Performer series is built for drummers looking for a versatile kit suited to both studio work and the demands of live performance.

name: Pearl Masters Maple Reserve
description: A high-end drum kit from Pearl's Masters Maple Reserve series. Designed with serious performers in mind, it offers a premium foundation for drummers seeking an expressive and professional setup.

name: Shure SM58
description: An industry-recognized dynamic vocal microphone trusted by performers around the world. The Shure SM58 is a familiar choice for live vocals, presentations, and general-purpose stage applications.

name: Shure Beta 58A
description: A premium supercardioid dynamic vocal microphone designed for live performance. The Beta 58A is an established option for vocalists seeking focused sound reproduction and dependable stage performance.

name: Shure Axient Digital ADX2
description: A professional wireless handheld transmitter from Shure's Axient Digital ecosystem. Designed for demanding production environments, it is intended for performers and audio professionals working with advanced wireless microphone systems.

name: DPA d:vote CORE 4099
description: A compact instrument microphone from DPA's d:vote series, designed to capture the natural character of musical instruments. A professional solution for live sound applications and instrument amplification.

name: Supro 1697RH Galaxy Head
description: A distinctive guitar amplifier head from Supro, bringing the brand's recognizable vintage-inspired character to a modern guitar rig. An appealing option for players looking to shape their own amplified sound.

name: Diezel Hagen 100W Head
description: A high-powered guitar amplifier head from German manufacturer Diezel. Designed for professional guitarists seeking a versatile amplification platform, particularly in demanding rock and metal environments.

name: Yamaha TF5 Digital Mixer
description: A professional digital mixing console from Yamaha's TF series. Designed to make live audio mixing more accessible and efficient, it is suitable for venues, production teams, and performing groups.

name: Focusrite Scarlett 18i20 3rd Gen
description: A versatile USB audio interface designed for home studios and professional recording environments. The Scarlett 18i20 provides extensive connectivity for recording multiple instruments and microphones in a single setup.

name: QSC K12.2 Powered Speaker
description: A professional powered loudspeaker from QSC's K.2 series. Designed for live sound reinforcement, performances, and event production, it offers a convenient all-in-one amplification solution.

name: Roland RD-2000
description: A professional stage piano from Roland, designed for keyboardists who need a versatile instrument for live performances and studio work. It combines expressive piano playing with a broad range of performance possibilities.

name: Nord Stage 3 Compact
description: A performance-oriented keyboard from Nord's Stage series. Designed for professional musicians, it brings multiple keyboard instrument sounds and performance capabilities together in a compact stage-ready format.

name: Roland Fantom-06
description: A versatile synthesizer workstation designed for musicians, composers, and performers. The Roland Fantom-06 provides a creative platform for building sounds, arranging music, and performing across different musical styles.

name: Elixir 10-57 Nanoweb Electric Guitar Strings
description: A set of electric guitar strings featuring Elixir's NANOWEB coating technology. Designed to maintain a consistent playing feel while helping protect strings from dirt and corrosion during regular use.

name: D'Addario EXL170 Bass Strings
description: A popular set of nickel-plated bass strings from D'Addario's XL series. Designed for electric bass players seeking a familiar feel and versatile sound suitable for a wide range of musical styles.

name: Dunlop Jazz III Nylon Guitar Pick (Set of 6)
description: A set of six Dunlop Jazz III nylon picks, known for their compact shape and precise playing feel. A popular choice among guitarists who value accuracy, control, and articulation.

name: D'Addario Planet Waves Classic Instrument Cable
description: A reliable instrument cable from D'Addario's Planet Waves range, designed to connect guitars, basses, and other compatible instruments to amplifiers and audio equipment.

name: On-Stage XCG4 Guitar Stand
description: A practical guitar stand from On-Stage, providing a convenient place to store and display your instrument when it is not being played. A useful addition to practice rooms, studios, and performance spaces.

name: Hercules KS100B Keyboard Stand
description: A sturdy keyboard stand from Hercules, designed to provide a stable platform for digital pianos and keyboards. A practical accessory for musicians setting up their home studios or live performance rigs.

name: Vic Firth American Classic 5A
description: A pair of American Classic 5A drumsticks from Vic Firth, one of the most recognizable drumstick models. Their versatile size makes them a familiar choice for drummers across a variety of musical styles.

name: Seymour Duncan Sentient/Nazgul Pickup Set
description: A matched pickup set from Seymour Duncan featuring the Sentient neck pickup and Nazgul bridge pickup. Designed with modern metal and high-gain guitar applications in mind, it offers players additional options for shaping their instrument's sound.
